agent_explanation: Controlled hover body 0 is struck by fast body 1 around step 28 (touching pair gap 0.005, body 0 speed 2.9). The collision impulse abruptly changes body 0 velocity to speed 10.27 at step 29 (vx -5.87, vy 8.42). The controller velocity-error law kp*(vDesired-vActual) then demands ~487 N, far above fmax 72.67, so the fmax clamp is missing/not applied on this post-collision update path.
